vibe.title: Vibe Coding
vibe.intro: This website —and other projects on my GitHub— is developed with the help of artificial intelligence. I believe in transparency: I don't hide my use of AI, I present it as a skill I'm proficient in. The value isn't in "generating code", but in directing the tools with technical judgment, defining good requirements and verifying the result.
vibe.workflowIntro: The workflow I used to ship this very website:

steps.name: Prompt-driven orchestration
steps.description: I defined the requirements in natural language: an Astro website, multilingual (CA/EN/ES), light/dark mode, LinkedIn and GitHub links, a professional IT-focused design, accessible and responsive.

steps.name: Specialized agents in a pipeline
steps.description: Kiro CLI orchestrated several AI agents in sequence: full-stack development → UI/UX design → QA. Each agent specialized in its own task.

steps.name: Verification & human control
steps.description: Clean build (Astro), automated visual testing with Playwright and an accessibility review (AA contrast, semantic HTML). The final decision and validation are human.

vibe.promptIntro: This is, in essence, the request that gave birth to the website:
vibe.promptText: "I want to create my personal website with Astro to gain visibility for a future job. On design, make it attractive, professional and IT-focused, pleasant to look at and easy to read. It should be available in Catalan, English and Spanish, with buttons to my LinkedIn and GitHub, and a toggle between light and dark mode."
